event.description: Tie attention and feed-forward pre-normalization within each block while retaining corresponding cross-layer normalization sharing, reversed operands, d=14, two heads, two blocks, ff=19, rank-3 learned positions, and the 45000-step schedule.
event.proposal: Family: parameter tying. Retained incumbent is 3073 parameters at 99.710000%, a +0.710000 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family history: the most recent accepted result is attempt-0038, corresponding LayerNorm sharing across blocks (3073, 99.71%); the most recent failed result is attempt-0039, final-normalization sharing, an optimization failure with 10.7% peak validation; 6 prior parameter-tying candidate attempts. Hypothesis: attention and feed-forward residual updates may use one shared pre-normalization affine calibration while the final output normalization remains distinct; with the existing cross-layer tie, this removes one further 14-scale-plus-14-offset vector, reducing actual parameters from 3073 to 3045. This is a parameter-tying change, not scalar pruning. It is more informative than final-normalization sharing because it preserves the output-specific calibration that the prior failure directly implicated.
